rawSolutionFindings.observation: Printed illuminance values and tolerance use lumen three times; the same allowed source defines illuminance as flux per area and its unit as lux. A flux is not an illuminance without area/measurement interpretation.
rawSolutionFindings.reproducibleReason: Compare E=Phi/S and 1 lx=1 lm/m^2 against printed 50 lm. Under the explicit vertical fixed-intensity point-source assumption solve 40<=50*(1.1/h)^2<=60, giving the closed conditional interval [sqrt(121/120),sqrt(121/80)] m. Substitution gives 60 and 40 at the respective boundaries, but does not resolve the unit conflict.
rawSolutionFindings.resolutionBoundary: Retain the faithful source unchanged. A later authorized edition must explicitly decide and bind either the intended illuminance-unit repair or a well-defined fixed-area received-flux reinterpretation before using this as an approved answer/choice truth.
